source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethics in terms of use (PDF 178).

blocks.text: Terms of Use ke ethical (akhlaqi) pehlu mein teen cheezein shamil hain: fairness (insaf), transparency (saaf goi) aur user ke rights ka ehtaram. Companies ke liye zaroori hai ke un ki terms saaf aur seedhi hon, bila wajah mushkil ya deceptive (dhoka dene wali) na hon. Provider ki akhlaqi zimmedari hai ke user poori tarah samjhe ke woh kin terms ko maan raha hai, na ke zaroori baatein lambe ya uljhe hue documents mein chhupa di jayein.

Misal: Pakistan mein jab koi online course mein sign up kare, to terms mein saaf likha ho ke certificate milega ya nahi, personal data kaise sambhala jayega, aur koi additional fees (izafi fees) hai ya nahi. Akhlaqi taur par bohat zaroori hai ke educational platforms user ko yeh dhoka na dein ke course muft hai jab ke asal mein us mein hidden costs (chhupe hue kharche) hon.

blocks.prompt: Zaroori baaton ko lambe aur uljhe hue document mein chhupana ghair akhlaqi kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke user us shart ko soch samajh kar maan hi nahi sakta jo use aasani se mile ya samajh na aaye. Is tarah provider ko na-insafi wala faida milta hai, aur yeh fairness aur transparency ke khilaf hai jo kitab ke mutabiq akhlaqi terms ki bunyad hain.

items: Akhlaqi Terms of Use: fair, transparent, user ke rights ka ehtaram; saaf aur seedhi, dhoke wali nahi.
Online course: certificate, data ka istemal aur izafi fees saaf likhi hon; chhupe kharchon wale course ko muft na dikhayein.
